instructions.purpose: Update exactly one resolved writable-calendar event.

tool.name: update-calendar-event
tool.description: Patches an event with an explicit recurrence scope and no calendar selector.

usage_rules.rule: Call list-calendar-events first and use its exact event ID. Clarify multiple matches.
Never guess recurrence scope. Require occurrence, following, or series from the user's intent.
Rescheduling and postponing are updates; do not create a replacement event.
For following scope, tell the user future exceptions reset if that consequence is material.

example.context: After resolving event abc, move this occurrence to 15:00.
